title: sorting
quote: Electre Tri is a set of methods designed to sort alternatives evaluated on several criteria into ordered categories.
context: Multi-criteria SORTING: a decision maker defines ordered categories by reference profiles; each alternative is assigned by comparison with them. Profiles and thresholds are elicited from the decision maker.
transfer: Direct fit: results are sorted into ordered categories — fits (base) > option (trade-off) > rejected. A category may have several limiting profiles: the BASE profile (every asked requirement incl. the anchor, e.g. the asked brands) and an OPTION profile (anchor partly missing, every other purpose requirement at a high level). Condition: profiles come from the asker's words, hints and the purpose, are shown to the owner and editable — never invented by the engine alone.

title: alternatives
quote: OR-refinement links relate a goal to an alternative set of refinements; this means that satisfying one of the refinements is sufficient for satisfying the parent goal.
context: Requirements engineering for SYSTEM design: alternative refinements are alternative designs to satisfy a system goal; chosen by analysts.
transfer: Transfer by analogy only: a purpose goal of the asker ("guests come for the natural setting") may be met by alternative means (sea near OR scenic surroundings). Condition: the parent goal is found by WHY from the asker's words/purpose; alternatives are proposed, voted and owner-confirmed; the asker's own requirement always stays one alternative. Does not license dropping an asker's must-have.

title: LLM reliability
quote: In addition, when evaluated by human annotators, GPT-4o generates goal model refinement relationships among extracted goals with 72.2% accuracy.
context: Goals extracted from stakeholder interview transcripts, judged by human annotators.
transfer: A model-proposed refinement (alternative, category profile) is wrong about 1 time in 4 in that setting: every such proposal needs independent-family votes (#212) and owner confirmation before it can change which items count.
